title: Master Mix Calculator Pro
subtitle: Professional tool for calculating reagents in lab protocols

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure your kit and reaction parameters

savedKits.title: Saved Kits
savedKits.description: Manage, import, or export your custom kits

kitModal.description: Configure your kit's reagents, protocol, and notes
kitModal.reactionVolumeHint: Master mix per reaction: {{mix}} µL. The remainder up to the final volume is filled with RNA + water in the sample table.

placeholders.protocol:
e.g., 1. Annealing: 65°C for 5 min
2. Synthesis: 50°C for 50 min
placeholders.notes: e.g., Lot #12345, Valid until 12/2025. Keep enzyme on ice.

defaultKit.name: Generic Kit (Example)
defaultKit.protocol:
1. Annealing: 25°C for 10 min
2. Synthesis: 37°C for 60 min
3. Synthesis: 37°C for 60 min (2nd cycle, 120 min total)
4. Inactivation: 85°C for 5 min
5. Hold: 4°C
defaultKit.notes: Generic kit. The 120 min synthesis is split into 2 × 60 min because the lab thermocycler limits each step to 60 min. Create your own kit for other protocols.

print.generatedOn: Protocol, Master Mix and Samples — generated on {{date}}

alerts.fillAllFields: Fill in the kit name and the name and volume (> 0) of every reagent.
alerts.invalidReactionVolume: Enter a final reaction volume greater than zero.
alerts.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this kit?
alerts.noKitsToExport: There are no custom kits to export.
alerts.importError: The file must contain a list of kits.
alerts.importSuccess: {{count}} of {{total}} kit(s) imported. Kits with duplicate IDs were skipped.

samples.title: Sample Preparation (RNA + Water)
samples.description: RNA and water volume per tube, from each sample's concentration
samples.summary: {{mass}} ng RNA per reaction · {{free}} µL RNA + water per tube
samples.noFreeVolume: The master mix already fills the whole reaction volume. Edit the kit and increase the "Final reaction volume" or reduce the water in the mix.
samples.exceedsBanner: {{count}} sample(s) do not fit at this mass. The highest mass that fits all samples is {{mass}} ng (limited by sample {{sample}}).
samples.lowBanner: {{count}} sample(s) need less than {{min}} µL of RNA — imprecise pipetting. Dilute the sample and update its concentration.
samples.confirmClear: Delete all samples from the table?
samples.hint: Tip: copy the Name and Concentration columns from Excel or NanoDrop and paste straight into a table cell. The number of rows follows the master mix "Number of Samples".
samples.pasteDescription: Paste rows from Excel, NanoDrop or CSV. The 1st column is the name and the 1st number after it is the concentration (ng/µL). Headers are ignored.

history.title: Experiment History
history.description: Experiments saved in this browser — open, print or load back into the calculator
history.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, operator, kit or sample
history.empty: No experiments saved yet. Use "Save experiment" in the master mix results.
history.confirmLoad: Load this experiment? The current settings and sample table will be replaced.
history.nothingToExport: There are no experiments to export.
history.importInvalid: The file must contain a list of experiments.
history.importSuccess: {{count}} of {{total}} experiment(s) imported. Duplicates were skipped.
history.storageFull: Could not save: browser storage is full. Export the history and delete old experiments.

bench.title: Bench mode
bench.step3Hint: Pipette water first, then RNA. Tap a tube to check it off.

qplate.hint: Opens qPlate Architect in a new tab with the sample list
qplate.noSamples: Fill in at least one sample in the table to send it to qPlate.

c1v1.title: Dilution (C1·V1 = C2·V2)
c1v1.description: Fill in three values and leave blank the one you want.
c1v1.invalid: The final concentration cannot exceed the stock (nor V1 exceed V2).
c1v1.hint: Use the same concentration unit for C1 and C2.
c1v1.leaveOne: Leave one of the four fields blank to calculate it.

serial.title: Serial dilution
serial.description: Standard curve or dilution series from a stock.
serial.recipe: Put {{diluent}} µL of diluent in each tube. Transfer {{transfer}} µL of stock to tube 1, mix, and pass {{transfer}} µL to the next, down to the last.
serial.note: Each tube ends with {{remaining}} µL; the last one keeps {{total}} µL (discard {{transfer}} µL from it to match).
serial.hint: Factor above 1 and up to 24 points.

solution.title: Solution preparation
solution.description: How much to weigh for a molar or % (w/v) solution.
solution.complete: Dissolve and bring the volume to {{volume}} {{unit}}.
solution.hint: Enter the concentration, volume and (for molar) the molar mass.

primer.title: Primer resuspension
primer.description: Lyophilized primer: stock and working solution. The amount (nmol) is on the tube label or spec sheet.
primer.stockResult: Add {{water}} µL of water (or TE) for a {{stock}} µM stock.
primer.workingResult: Working ({{volume}} µL at {{working}} µM): {{stockVolume}} µL stock + {{water}} µL water.
primer.hint: Enter the nmol in the tube.

centrifuge.title: Centrifuge: rpm ↔ × g
centrifuge.description: RCF = 1.118 × 10⁻⁵ × radius (cm) × rpm². The rotor radius is in the manual or on the lid.
centrifuge.hint: Enter the radius and type rpm or × g.

cells.title: Cell count (Neubauer) and plating
cells.description: Count the 4 large corner squares. With trypan blue 1:1, the dilution factor is 2.
cells.dead: Dead cells per square (optional, for viability)
cells.platingResult: Mix {{suspension}} µL of suspension + {{medium}} µL of medium.
cells.platingTotal: Total of {{total}} µL with {{cells}} cells (margin included).
cells.notEnough: The suspension is too dilute: the required volume exceeds the total. Spin down and resuspend in less medium.
cells.platingHint: Fill in cells per well, number of wells and volume per well.
